gui.realmmarkets.title: Realm Markets
gui.realmmarkets.hold_plain_item: Hold an unmodified item to set this offer.
gui.realmmarkets.buyer_explanation: Items go into your inventory. Prices are per item; the total is shown above. The merchant can be offline.
gui.realmmarkets.wait_timeout: The stall did not answer. Refreshing shortly…
gui.realmmarkets.owner_hint: Hold an item to set an offer. Scroll to manage stock and collect sales.
gui.realmmarkets.buyer_hint: Choose an offer and quantity. Check the total before buying.
gui.realmmarkets.configured: Item and unit price saved. Add real items to fill the shelf.
gui.realmmarkets.purchased: Purchase complete. Your items are in your inventory.
gui.realmmarkets.claimed: Sales collected. Any amount that did not fit stays in the stall.
gui.realmmarkets.stall_unavailable: This stall has no available market record.
gui.realmmarkets.session_expired: Visit the physical stall again to continue.
gui.realmmarkets.stall_range: Stay near the complete physical stall to trade.
gui.realmmarkets.location_reserved: This location already belongs to a stall.
gui.realmmarkets.market_limit: This world has reached its stall limit.
gui.realmmarkets.offer_changed: This offer changed. Check the updated item and price before buying.
gui.realmmarkets.plain_item_required: Use an unmodified item without custom data or enchantments.
gui.realmmarkets.nothing_to_claim: There are no sales to collect yet.
gui.realmmarkets.inventory_full: There is not enough room in your main inventory.
gui.realmmarkets.wallet_full: Your wallet cannot hold any more money.
gui.realmmarkets.owner_required: Only the stall's owner can do that.
gui.realmmarkets.offer_missing: Set up this offer before adding stock or trading.
gui.realmmarkets.item_unavailable: This item is unavailable on the server.
gui.realmmarkets.stock_missing: You do not have enough matching unmodified items.
gui.realmmarkets.insufficient_funds: You do not have enough money for this purchase.
gui.realmmarkets.chronicles_unavailable: Your Chronicles character or wallet is unavailable. This stall keeps its original currency.
gui.realmmarkets.invalid_request: That action could not be completed. Check the quantity, stock and price.
gui.realmmarkets.operation_failed: The action could not be completed. Your items and funds remain protected.
gui.realmmarkets.break_denied: Only the owner can remove a stall. Take all stock and collect all sales first.
